Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: six-panel educational research comic for a bilingual science website.
Primary request: Create a polished landscape comic titled "CB-WCE: Training for changing traffic". Six equal panels arranged in 2 rows and 3 columns, read left to right. Friendly coherent hand-drawn scientific manhua. Teal, navy and amber traffic palette, cream background, crisp dark lettering. A friendly traffic-signal researcher character and stylized road intersections recur across panels. Short legible text; prioritize exact wording and numbers. High resolution wide layout.
Panel 1: Busy intersection, changing traffic directions, researcher considering varying car arrivals. Heading "1 · Traffic changes". Caption "Can a signal policy handle changing demand?"
Panel 2: Researcher trains one parent controller, illustrated as one model block connected to a traffic signal. Heading "2 · Shared parent". Caption "Train once: 1,000,000 learning steps".
Panel 3: Parent block has a lock; separate WCE model learns from demand scenarios, mixing three color-coded streams. Heading "3 · Learn demand mixtures". Caption "Freeze parent; train WCE for 500 episodes". Small clear note "Fixed parameters ≠ fixed mixture weights". Small note "Weights can vary with state."
Panel 4: One shared parent branches fairly into five labeled paths, no winner or ranking. Heading "4 · Five branches". Labels exactly "baseline", "random_group", "domain_randomization", "fixed_wce", "online_wce". Small note "fixed_wce: parameters frozen; weights may vary".
Panel 5: Five equal controllers each receive same training-time allocation. Heading "5 · Equal learning budget". Caption "Each: +1,320,000 learning steps". Strong number line "Total: 2,320,000 per branch".
Panel 6: Researcher tests controller at unseen traffic intersections, looking at queues through magnifying glass and a question mark indicating uncertainty. Heading "6 · Test unseen demand". Caption "Measure queues and uncertainty". Prominent speech bubble "More robust? A hypothesis to test."
Small footer across bottom: "Networks: 5×5 grid • Monaco subnet | Agents: IA2C • MA2C • IQL-LR • PPO"
Constraints: Exactly six panels in two rows and three columns, no extra panels, readable exact English wording above, all steps labelled learning steps, no performance charts, no fabricated results or success claim, no podiums, medals or ranking. Explain methodology, not measured findings. Fixed WCE model parameters do not imply constant state-dependent demand-mixture weights. Do not add other text.
